rationale: The reliable custody chain establishes continuity between the recorded attachment and binding events. It does not establish D-17’s original authorial arrangement or prove that arrangement remained unchanged; the ledger explicitly excludes relevant earlier and unobserved events.

signal_basis.exact_text: Two reliable witnesses record the identified opening leaves being attached to D-17 on 4 June. A continuous safeguarded chain connects that packet to a witnessed binding of D-17 on 7 June.
The ledger covers only these events and provides no record of earlier composition, unobserved rearrangements or authorial intention.
